solutionSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 1) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM shipments;

rules.howSolved: Relied on AVG ignoring NULL weight_kg values, with no explicit filter.
Wrapped AVG(weight_kg) in ROUND(..., 1) and aliased it avg_weight_kg.

ambiguities: The ticket does not name a rounding rule. I used PostgreSQL numeric ROUND, which rounds half away from zero.
notes: AVG over integer returns numeric, which matches the declared type. Sample returns a single row. Row counts per dataset: sample=1, nulls=1, boundary=1. Ran on every listed dataset without error.
